complete_examples.text: In the wheel-rail contact element, the representation of wheel-rail interaction is transformed from the interaction force form, i.e., the wheel-rail interaction element, into the spring-dashpot element form, i.e., the wheel-rail contact element.
The prototype of the wheel-rail contact element is illustrated in Fig. 1.
